Name: Claude Code Control
Description: Drive Claude Code from your VSD Craft device.

com.sandeep.claudecode.command.Name: Send Command
com.sandeep.claudecode.command.Tooltip: Type a slash command or prompt into the focused Claude Code session.

com.sandeep.claudecode.key.Name: Send Key
com.sandeep.claudecode.key.Tooltip: Send a Claude Code control key (Interrupt, Submit, Toggle mode, ...).

com.sandeep.claudecode.tab.Name: Switch Session
com.sandeep.claudecode.tab.Tooltip: Jump to a terminal tab where a Claude Code session runs.

com.sandeep.claudecode.dial.Name: Session Dial
com.sandeep.claudecode.dial.Tooltip: Rotate to move through history/tabs; press to interrupt.
